[LCDB.5.1] **A rule header's modifiers are the rate modifier and its key.**
The tail-side `rule_modifier*` list of [LGRA.6.1], whose productions are the
grammar's, admits exactly two members: `cooldown`, the rate modifier
([LCDB.3.2]), and `by:`, the activation key it is keyed on ([LCDB.3.3.4]).
